access.needsPlanTitle: Your workspace needs a plan to open the admin area
access.needsPlanBody: The admin pages, the queue dashboard, the API docs and the metrics endpoint open only while the operator's own workspace has a plan in force. Yours has none, so each of them answers not found. On a self-hosted instance with billing on, you can also set plan on the bootstrap workspace in the database.

runDaily.title: Start a daily run for {name}?
runDaily.body: Queues the app refreshes, keyword checks, reviews and category ranks of {name} that have not run yet today, and queues again the ones that failed. A job of today the queue still holds is skipped, so work that already ran is usually not repeated.
runDaily.nothingQueued: Nothing new to queue for {name} today.

reconcile.title: Reconcile {name} with Stripe?
reconcile.body: Reads the subscription of {name} from Stripe and corrects the plan, trial and renewal stored here when they differ. If Stripe has no subscription for it, {name} moves to Free, and a trial Stripe should not have started is cancelled. Nothing is charged.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.body: Every write and on demand action in {name} is refused until you restore it. Every member of {name} sees this reason on every page, so write it for them.

restore.title: Restore {name}?
restore.body: {name} may write again, and the suspension notice disappears for its members. The reason is kept in the access log.
